name: carma-analytics-fotda
description: CARMA Analytics is a secure, scalable and cloud agnostic data architecture to enable research analysis on big data sets by defining repeatable and scalable processes for ingesting data, creation of a data repository to fuse, process and perform quality assurance.

paragraphs: CARMA Analytics is a secure, scalable and cloud agnostic data architecture to enable research analysis on big data sets by defining repeatable and scalable processes for ingesting data, creation of a data repository to fuse, process and perform quality assurance. The architecture also identifies the tools required for data analysis for the research teams. This architecture addresses the following:

features: Data ingested using a direct connection from an on-prem sandbox (ex. Isilon at TFHRC's STOL lab)
Data ingested from a remote test environment (ex. using AWS snowball when a direct connection is not available)
Moving or accessing data from other static and real-time sources to support basic test/dev activities
